name: Benizalón (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided, the upper half white with a red canton at the fly, the lower half blue with a green triangle rising from the base to the centre, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Benizalón (a wall gate and a mountain with a flower).
history: Benizalón applied on 18 May 2005 to register the arms and flag in use, receiving approval in January 2007; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 divided into two equal horizontal stripes, the upper white and the lower blue with a green triangle based on the width of the flag and pointing to its centre.

features.role: red rectangle in the upper fly
triangle based on the bottom edge
Benizalón arms — wall gate, mountain and flower
